top_choice_rationale: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles rest on a clear physical-chemical design rule (headgroup pKa near neutral in blood, cationic in the endosome, PEG-lipid control of particle formation, controlled-mixing encapsulation) that is mature, independently reproduced and enabled patisiran and the mRNA vaccines; it is a single coherent achievement with a delivery scope distinct from the 2023 Medicine prize, and the citation can be worded around the design principle to limit the attribution dispute over later lipids. Base editing alone (Liu) is my second choice for its designed reactivity on a single nucleobase, then protein degradation, while two-part slates pairing unrelated achievements rank lower.
